meta.title: Mandatory T&Cs must be accepted by vendors before submitting bids
warnings: resolved: “Selecting and accepting every mandatory T&C checkbox in the vendor portal when the individual clause labels are not know” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

plan.title: Mandatory T&C acceptance before vendor bid

steps.note: Open the eRFX event creation screen.
Apply the first available template so line items and the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add one product for the vendor bid.
Complete the pricing sheet before publishing.

args.goal: open the event-level Terms and Conditions editor, mark all existing T&Cs as mandatory, click Done, and stop on the create screen showing the saved mandatory configuration

steps.note: Configure the mandatory event-level terms, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Publish the event with mandatory T&Cs enabled.
Confirm the event was published successfully.
Move to the invited vendor session.
Open the event's pricing bid sheet in the supplier portal.
Try to submit without accepting the mandatory T&Cs and require a refusal or disabled submission.

args.need: accept every mandatory T&C checkbox in the vendor portal for this event

steps.note: The individual vendor-side clauses and controls are not expressible by known catalog labels.
Submit the bid after the mandatory T&Cs have been accepted.
Verify the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
